system.description: Spend three Blood Traits and 10 minutes to extrude a tough, fibrous cocoon around yourself that blocks sunlight and negates the first two health levels of fire damage per turn. Attackers must defeat the cocoon's strength in a Static Physical Challenge against twice your Physical Traits before striking you. You may use mental Disciplines while cocooned if their requirements can otherwise be met, and may emerge at no cost at any time.
